intro: Working tools I've built. Each one is live: try it, break it, tell me what you'd change.

tools.title: Storytime with Papa
tools.q: What if tonight's bedtime story was written for tonight's feeling?
tools.d: Writes an original read-aloud picture book for ages 3 to 5 from a feeling and a setting: a small hero, a refrain to chant, three tries and a twist. Comes with illustration notes and a page-by-page reading mode. Runs on Claude, so it needs a Claude sign-in.
